scheme_name: Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged – Speech Impaired
other_conditions: Applicant must be hearing challenged and speech impaired
Applicant must know sign language and be able to communicate directly with another person using sign language
Applicant must be able to use Video Relay Service (VRS) with an interpreter as the intermediary
benefits_summary: Touch phones are provided to eligible individuals, with the cost fully or partially covered based on parent/guardian income.
